statements.impact_statement: The affected Docker daemon authorization handler is not executed. Alloy reaches this module through cAdvisor client imports; this deployment reads container log files and has no Docker control socket.

The affected Docker daemon archive-upload handler is not executed. Alloy reaches this module through cAdvisor client imports; this deployment reads container log files and has no Docker control socket.
The affected Docker daemon copy/archive path is not executed. Alloy reaches this module through cAdvisor client imports; this deployment reads container log files and has no Docker control socket.
The affected Docker daemon plugin-install privilege validation is not executed. Alloy imports Docker client code through cAdvisor, has no Docker socket, and cannot install Docker plugins.
The affected Docker daemon copy/archive handler is not executed. Alloy imports Docker client code through cAdvisor, has no Docker socket, and cannot invoke docker cp or the archive API.
